effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.heavy_hand: Your Crush attacks deal +2 raw damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.follow_through: Deal +3 raw damage to a foe with 8 or more armour before the hit.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.overbear: Make a heavy Crush attack now, then skip your next personal turn.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.bracing_stance: Deal +3 raw damage while you have held the same rank since your previous action.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.stagger: Landed Crush hits have a 30% chance to move the foe one place later next round.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.shatter: Strike one foe and permanently reduce its armour for this encounter, to a minimum of 0.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.momentum: Gain raw damage from gear initiative penalty: 40% of the penalty, rounded down, maximum +4.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.force.breaking_blow: Crush hits ignore armour; the first landed Crush hit each personal turn also Staggers.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.keen_eye: Your Pierce attacks deal +2 raw damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.weak_point: Deal +3 raw damage when the foe's covering density is 50 or more.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.pry: Make a lower-power Pierce attack that ignores armour.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.steady_hand: Landed attacks have a 12% chance to deal ×1.5 raw damage before armour.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.exploit: Deal +4 raw damage to a foe with Burn, Poison, Dazzle or Bleed.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.finish: Strike one foe at full power below the shown HP threshold, or one-third power above it.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.anatomy: The party gains 35% more butchery output while you took part in the expedition; copies do not stack.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.precision.killing_stroke: Defeat a surviving non-apex foe at 15% HP or less after your hit; apexes take +4 damage instead.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.light_touch: Halve initiative penalties from equipped gear, rounding toward 0.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.quicken: Take one extra action now, then skip your next personal turn; cannot combine with Blur this turn.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.second_wind: When you defeat a foe, recover 3 HP if still conscious.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.flurry: A landed direct attack carries 40% of damage dealt to one other legal foe; it cannot chain.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.first_strike: On your first completed action, attack for +4 raw damage without allowing retaliation.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.cascade: Each foe you defeat grants +3 initiative for this encounter, up to three times.
effectCopyByNode.combat.offense.swiftness.blur: Once per encounter, take two ordinary actions without spending this action; cannot combine with Quicken this turn.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.thick_hide: Gain +6 maximum and starting expedition HP.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.iron_skin: Gain +2 armour after equipment and sturdiness.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.brace: Reduce incoming damage through your next enemy-action window.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.constitution: Burn, Poison, Dazzle and Bleed on you last half as many rounds, rounded up.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.endurance: At half HP or less, reduce final incoming damage by 25%, without passing the global minimum.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.ward: Choose one disclosed harm kind; reduce matching harm until the Ward expires.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.unyielding: Once per encounter, harm that would pass you out leaves you at 1 HP.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.fortitude.immovable: Your armour also applies against Pierce, Heat, Caustic and Light damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.bulwark: Gain +1 armour; allies in your rank gain +2 armour while you are conscious. Copies use only the strongest bonus.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.watchful: If an ordinary creature ambushes the party, cancel its free opening actions and use normal initiative.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.draw_off: Choose one foe; while Draw Off lasts, it targets you whenever legally able.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.cover: While conscious in front, take 30% of final damage aimed at a back-rank ally; Cover cannot chain.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.shieldwall: While conscious in front, every conscious front-rank party member gains +2 armour.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.interpose: Receive the next legal hit meant for an ally, then the effect ends.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.rally: When you defeat a foe, every other conscious party member recovers 2 HP.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.protection.guardian: While conscious in front, foes cannot directly target the back rank when a legal front target exists.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.footwork: Foes are 6 percentage points more likely to miss you.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.sidestep: The next otherwise legal attack against you misses; its affliction also fails.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.slippery: Halve the chance that an ordinary encounter begins as an ambush; party copies do not stack.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.fall_back: Change your rank without spending your action; this ends Bracing Stance.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.feint: After your direct attack, gain +10 percentage-point evasion until your next completed action.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.untouchable: At round end, gain +5 percentage-point evasion if targeted but not hit, up to +20; a hit resets it.
effectCopyByNode.combat.defense.evasion.ghost: The first otherwise legal attack against you each encounter misses.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.tainted_edge: Landed direct weapon hits apply weak Poison: 1 damage for 2 rounds, unless stronger Poison is present.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.apothecary_s_hand: Beneficial items you use gain +50% magnitude or duration; harmful thrown items are unchanged.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.envenom: Temporarily coat your weapon with Poison for this encounter without using an inventory coating.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.virulence: Afflictions you directly apply last +2 rounds after resistance.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.flense: Wound one foe; denser covering makes the hit stronger and the Bleed keeps opening.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.corrode: The first tick each round from Poison you applied reduces that foe's armour by 1.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.distiller: Coatings prepared for you use 40% fewer positive world-resource ingredients, rounded up; Essence is unchanged.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.venom.blight: New or strengthened Poison you apply copies at half strength and duration to one other foe; it cannot spread again.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.sparkhand: Landed direct weapon hits apply weak Burn: 1 damage for 2 rounds, unless stronger Burn is present.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.insulation: Choose Heat, Caustic or Light when learned; take 35% less matching emanation damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.emanation_strike: Strike with chosen Heat, Caustic or Light, applying Burn, Poison or Dazzle respectively.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.attunement: Emanation Strike and Channelworks attacks deal +3 raw damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.snuff: Suppress one foe's active emanation for 2 rounds.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.quench: Choose one ally and remove one selected Burn, Poison or Dazzle; Bleed and unchosen conditions remain.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.conduction: A direct emanation hit carries 50% damage and half-duration affliction to one other foe; it cannot chain.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.emanation.emanant: Choose Heat, Caustic or Light when learned. Ordinary direct attacks carry its weak matching affliction; matching Sparkhand or Tainted Edge strengthens that application, while a nonmatching root remains separate.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.quiet_step: Once per ordinary roaming creature, turn its first distant movement detection into one visible alert turn instead of immediate pursuit.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.low_profile: Reduce the party's detection radius by 1 tile. This actor also gains +6 evasion during an ordinary creature ambush's foe-only opening actions.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.conceal: Prevent direct targeting while another legal target exists for the effect's duration.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.opportunist: Your first direct hit while concealed or immediately after emerging deals +5 raw damage.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.ambush: Before your first completed action when the party was not ambushed, make one free direct attack; only one free opening attack is allowed.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.vanish: Once per expedition, the confirmed ordinary combat retreat costs no Stability.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.shadowed: Reduce the party's detection radius by 2 tiles, replacing Low Profile's field reduction but not its personal ambush-opening evasion.
effectCopyByNode.combat.craft.shadow.unseen: Begin ordinary encounters concealed through the end of the first ordinary round; this does not cancel an ambush.
